experiments.objective: Improve 3M/6M/1Y selected-vs-not-selected return while preserving mild drawdown advantage.
experiments.hypothesis: A medium-horizon relative-strength confirmation after fundamentals ranking will remove weak follow-through names.
success_rules: No material MDD deterioration versus baseline

latest_result.note: 3M and 6M improved versus baseline, but 1Y return delta remains slightly negative and MDD deteriorates across all horizons.

experiments.objective: Reduce selection of already overextended names and improve medium-horizon follow-through.
experiments.hypothesis: Penalizing names too far above long trend or too far above recent range will improve 3M/6M returns.
success_rules: MDD no worse than baseline by more than 1.5%p

latest_result.note: Standalone overheat caps did not improve 6M or 1Y and worsened MDD. If reused later, it should be combined with stronger momentum or quality confirmation.

experiments.objective: Rebuild S2 around Top3 entry signals: fundamentals acceleration plus long-trend alignment.
experiments.hypothesis: Top3 entry starts are more aligned with acceleration and trend quality than with plain growth score rank.

latest_result.note: Top3 entry signals alone were not sufficient to beat the S2-style universe on 3M/6M/1Y. This suggests entry-start common traits are useful research hints but not a full ranking replacement.

experiments.objective: Combine medium-horizon momentum confirmation with Top3-entry acceleration/trend ranking.
experiments.hypothesis: Momentum confirmation filters the weak names, and Top3 entry signals improve ranking quality among the survivors.

latest_result.note: Hybridizing momentum confirmation with Top3-entry ranking improved over the pure Top3 redesign, but still failed to deliver positive 3M/6M/1Y return deltas versus the investable universe.

experiments.objective: Retain S3 return edge while reducing MDD cost.
experiments.hypothesis: Adding a volatility/risk penalty to the ranking should preserve alpha but remove the worst path-risk names.
success_rules: MDD delta improves on at least 2 horizons

experiments.objective: Recover selection alpha on 3M/6M/1Y where current Core2 underperforms non-selected names.
experiments.hypothesis: Core2 needs a broader score than mom20 + volume ratio, with quality confirmation and better gate interaction.
success_rules: 1Y return gap materially improved versus baseline

experiments.objective: Reduce weak carry and improve post-selection path quality.
experiments.hypothesis: Gate and exit redesign can remove names that score well on entry but do not persist over 6M/1Y.
success_rules: Return delta does not worsen on 3M
